title.en: Income Tax (Lendlease Global Commercial REIT — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Lendlease Global Commercial REIT — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2020.

2.—(1) Distribution income received in Singapore by Lendlease Global Commercial (IT) Pte Ltd (a company incorporated in Singapore) from Lendlease Global Commercial Italy Fund (a real estate investment fund constituted in Italy) on or after 25 June 2019 is exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption in sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the conditions specified in the letter of approval dated 10 September 2019 addressed to Ernst & Young Solutions LLP.
